title: Cryptoassets standard and other miscellaneous amendments: consultation on return templates — Return template: MA(BS)3 Part IIIb
summary: HKMA's document ledger lists this item as 'Return template: MA(BS)3 Part IIIb,' issued 13 June 2025 as part of a wider package titled 'Cryptoassets standard and other miscellaneous amendments: consultation on return templates.' That package consults Authorized Institutions on proposed new or amended banking return forms, incorporating a prudential 'cryptoassets standard' for how banks report cryptoasset exposures, alongside separate, unrelated housekeeping changes; this specific document is one of several individual return-template, explanatory-note, and completion-instruction annexes HKMA issued the same day as part of the same consultation. HKMA's document repository (brdr.hkma.gov.hk) returned a server error (HTTP 503) on every attempt to retrieve this document during this review, so the specific changes proposed to this particular annex are not confirmed against its own text; this summary is limited to what HKMA's own consultations feed listing for this item states.
why_it_matters: HKMA requires the banks it supervises to file standardised prudential returns, and this is one of the forms being amended specifically to capture cryptoasset exposure. For a newcomer, it is a sign that cryptoasset exposure is becoming a routine, reportable line item in bank supervision, not just a niche licensing topic.
